dedupe_keys.name: newr non potable environmental and economic water reuse calculator us epa

description: NEWR is a web calculator for screening-level assessment of source water options for onsite non-potable water reuse in urban buildings anywhere in the United States. From the building's location, climate, size and type it identifies the most environmentally and cost-effective suite of source waters (such as wastewater, greywater, stormwater, roof rainwater and air-conditioning condensate) for uses like toilet flushing, laundry and irrigation, using life cycle assessment to ISO 14040/44, including avoided impacts of central supply, and life cycle cost assessment. The US EPA Office of Research and Development built it as a single-page web application available free in any modern browser; the Data.gov entry (last updated February 2021) cites the EPA ScienceHub licence. Coverage is national for US urban locations. Caveats: it is a screening tool, not a detailed engineering assessment, and is recommended for buildings with 50 or more occupants. Simulation uses: comparing decentralised reuse options in capacity planning and optimisation of building water supply, and drought adaptation. Related record: the wastewater treatment unit process removal and cost dataset (data-wastewater-treatment-unit-processes-removal-costs).
inputs: Urban building location, climate, building size and building type (screening for buildings with 50 or more occupants)
Candidate source waters for non-potable reuse (wastewater, greywater, stormwater, roof rainwater, AC condensate)
